clauses.quote: 余得驗者止驗生旺墓絕其餘不驗不必用之
火生在寅四大生理之正也
且如主象臨午火火墓於戌後逢辰日則應之餘倣此
伏神被旺相之飛神尅害者三也

interpretation.query_model: Each listed phase has its stated branch and a branch has one phase for a given element. A known different phase excludes the requested phase; an unknown branch excludes a requested phase only if that phase mapping is present. Unlisted requested phases remain unknown. This is a deterministic evaluation model, not a newly discovered fire table.
interpretation.aggregation: Kleene OR for alternative queried positions. A verified position cannot be erased by another unknown position. A position relation does not certify actual tomb/cessation.
interpretation.applicability: The hidden target queries its own month/day/flying positions. Missing flying-stage data remains blocking where flying pressure is in dispute; it is not a new adverse condition when the flying element cannot control the independently supported hidden target.

scope: 仅核已列阶段位置及本次查询完整性；不填补火帝旺与绝位，不把位置关系当成真墓真绝或现实成败。
